title: Toward Culturally Aligned LLMs through Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions on regional social-survey benchmarks (e.g., EVS, GSS, CGSS, ISD, LAPOP, Afrobarometer) by casting value-related questions into binary decision tasks and measuring accuracy and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) compared to empirical human survey responses to detect Western-centric defaults and value misalignment.
